{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-mi-s","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"6db0d576549812f55eed78cad1490d8d816d564dc8c508e87a566b1e1f79b62a","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-mi-class-std:lineage:84","source_registry_sha256":"7af7437894a2c63b20529c8a1ed7c10696796036051dd6666178ab579008ca37","source_liveness_sha256":"e81e5179580dc89fb25fdf5194e9f75291db3aa019fc21ccfe32c38d1a9df42f"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Graduated Driver Licensing and application documents","heading":"C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Graduated Driver Licensing","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Graduated Driver Licensing

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
Segment 1 can begin at 14 years, 8 months, but the Level 1 Learner’s License cannot be issued until 14 years, 9 months, so the two ages differ by one month. [A01]
Why it matters: group gdl-ages; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F02, sec02-F05 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A02
The Segment 2 log needs 30 supervised hours with 2 at night, while the skills test needs the full 50 hours with 10 at night. [A02]
Why it matters: group gdl-hours; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F10, sec02-F12, sec02-F14 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A02
Segment 2 requires three consecutive months on the Level 1 license, while the skills test and Level 2 each require at least six months on Level 1. [A02]
Why it matters: group gdl-time; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F12, sec02-F14, sec02-F16 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A02
Applying for GDL Level two requires ninety days free of violations, at-fault crashes, and suspensions, whereas GDL Level three requires holding Level two at least six months and driving twelve consecutive months without a moving violation, at-fault crash, suspension, or GDL restriction violation [A02].
Why it matters: group gdl-record; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F16, sec02-F22 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
The minimum ages climb by level: 15 for the skills test, 16 for Level 2, and 17 for Level 3. [A02]
Why it matters: group gdl-ages; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F14, sec02-F16, sec02-F22 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
The Level 2 night limit runs from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m., while the passenger limit applies at any hour and allows only one passenger under 21. [A02]
Why it matters: group gdl-restrictions; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F19, sec02-F20 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A02
Immediate family passengers are an exception to the Level 2 passenger limit, but they are not listed as an exception to the night driving limit. [A02]
Why it matters: group gdl-restrictions; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F19, sec02-F20 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A02
A supervising adult who is not the parent or guardian must be licensed, at least 21, and carry the parent’s signed authorization letter. [A02]
Why it matters: group gdl-supervision; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F08, sec02-F09 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A02
Hard-card teens advance to Level 2 automatically, while paper-card teens must bring their documents to a Secretary of State office. [A02]
Why it matters: group gdl-process; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F17, sec02-F18 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A02
The Segment 1 and Segment 2 driver education state exams share the same minimum score of 70 percent [A02] [A01].
Why it matters: group gdl-exams; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F04, sec02-F13 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A02
Adults must practice at least 30 days on a TIP before the skills test, a count of days, whereas the teen log counts supervised hours [A02] [A03].
Why it matters: group adult-path; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F28, sec02-F10 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A03
The Social Security ineligibility letter may be at most 60 days old, while residency bills and statements must be from the last 90 days. [A03]
Why it matters: group documents; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F30, sec02-F35 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A03
The written knowledge test costs nothing at an office, and only the optional online version at home carries the $6.50 convenience fee. [A03]
Why it matters: group adult-path; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F26 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0020]
